description: Cancer cell line lookup with DepMap IDs, from Cellosaurus (SIB, the reference cell line knowledge base): find a line by name (e.g. MCF-7), Cellosaurus accession (CVCL_…) or DepMap ID (ACH-…), or list DepMap lines for a disease. Returns names and synonyms, DepMap ID, ATCC catalog number, disease (NCIt), species, sex, donor age, sampling site, genetic ancestry and the Cellosaurus link. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

disease.description: Disease text, e.g. breast carcinoma (lists DepMap-linked lines)

name.description: Cell line name, e.g. MCF-7, HeLa, A549

name: health_cell_line_depmap_cancer
title: Health Cell Line Depmap Cancer
